_crawl.linkedin_about: How did it all start? From the onset 3G Stores wanted to do something different-we gave you an opportunity to try out our products, from live phones to using broadband in association with different digital lifestyle products including online gaming, music and photography applications. We were also one of the few in the Irish Market to provide you with a complete range of mobile and fixed communications solutions. What happened next? We listened to your needs-you told us that you needed variety and so we focused on developing strong partnerships that would not only help us deliver value but also a choice from marketing leading brands such as Meteor and 3, Eircom and Apple. Now 5 years on and with 22 stores nationwide, 3G Stores is poised to embark on a journey of growth and transformation... What's in a name? We are changing our name to 3G Mobile and our logo as well. As you can see the logo is a tree-a tree symbolises many things and soon you will see what the tree means to us...we also have introduced a new tag line 'Let's grow together'. We want to grow together with you our customer, to evolve as you evolve, to meet your needs. Open to all... We currently employ 160 people nationwide and this number is set to increase as each new store opens. Alot of time and effort will be continued to be invested into training, ensuring that all of us are always ready to answer any of your questions from mobile phones to broadband, i pods to Apple Macs. More to come... ...when you come into 3G Mobile you will have a shopping experience like no other as we are set to reveal a dramatic new look.

## 30 Years of Distribution Experience

With 33 years in the I.T distribution business - we curate, procure and distribute a wide range of
tech products across the region.
Ban Leong Technologies Pte Ltd empowers businesses and resellers with access to leading I.T brands

[ Read More ][35]

## What We Do

#### Retail Distribution

As a leading distribution partner in the industry, we work with large-format retail chains to
specialist tech stores and independent retailers to deliver market coverage and accessibility to
consumers. With a focus on demand generation, we possess dedicated resources in our sales and
marketing teams to drive vendor objectives.

#### Commercial Distribution

With a growing network of over 1,000 system integrators and resellers, our commercial division
strives to deliver the best solutions and products for your business. Lead generation, events, and
outbound marketing services are part of our extensive brand offerings and services to help you win
deals and grow your business.

#### Ecommerce Enablement

Working with Singapore's top e-commerce platforms, we actively manage official brand stores and
assist brands with the expansion of their online businesses and logistics operations in Singapore.
From product listing and campaign management to order processing and fulfilment, we partner with our
vendors to optimize their digital channels to maximize online visibility and drive conversions.

## Product Management

Going beyond traditional distribution models of “box-moving” services. Our Marketing and Product
teams are key drivers in delivering vendor objectives and managing brand portfolios in-country.

We also constantly focus on identifying innovative IT products in both commercial and consumer
segments to enhance and expand our range.

#### Sales and Marketing


At the heart of our company are our Sales and Marketing divisions. Dedicated to driving business and
creating value to our vendors and customers alike.

We actively seek opportunities in brand building and in-country marketing. Covering multi-channel
approach in Events, PR, Channel Marketing, Digital Marketing and Social Media.

#### Logistics Support


With an integrated inventory management system as well as warehouse storage facilities and our fleet
of delivery vehicles, we provide end-to-end logistic solutions for our vendors and customers.

Our shipping department also manages inbound and outbound shipments from our network of vendors
around the world.

#### After Sales Service


Leveraging on our expertise and knowledge on IT products, we offer aftersales services in terms of
repairs and replacement according to warranties offered by manufacturers.

Our technical support team operates hotlines and walk-in service centers at our office locations
regionally to fulfil product support queries.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Bechtle is one of Europe’s leading IT service providers. We create future-ready IT architectures encompassing on-prem and multi-cloud infrastructures, digital transformation and modern workplace solutions, robust security, artificial intelligence and a full range of managed services. At the same time, we strengthen our customers’ digital sovereignty by embedding technological self-determination, transparency and resilience across our solutions. Our customers also benefit from our smart financing solutions and circular IT offering, helping them achieve their ESG goals. Through our subsidiaries, we are recognised as a leading specialist in enterprise applications, particularly PLM and ERP solutions. Operating from 120 locations across 14 European countries, we combine personal, local service with a digital offering as part of our global multichannel strategy. With over 16,000 employees, we are always close to our B2G and B2B customers, from SMEs to large international organisations. Bechtle is listed on the MDAX and TecDAX indexes. In 2025, the company generated a business volume of €8.6 bn. Privacy Policy and Legal notice: https://www.bechtle.com/de-en/privacy-policy/rechtliches

### Why Bluechip

Bluechip thrives with solutions and technology in Australia & New Zealand, providing leading
business solutions for our value-added resellers, managed service providers, integrators and
consultants.

Our customers need end-to-end solutions for their network, security and cloud services to achieve
their transformation goals. Bluechip’s commitment is to create value for our Partners and their
customers by focusing on business outcomes delivered by technology through this journey.

[Learn More][33]

### Leading Innovative Solutions

Established in 2000, Bluechip Infotech focuses on delivering the latest IT products to a wide
channel base while maintaining a dedicated commitment to first-class service. With offices across
Australia and New Zealand, we’re able to back our commitment to service through localised support.

### Supporting Our People & Partners

Bluechip invests in its people and their education. You have the leverage to staff from various
backgrounds who can support your business with their diverse blend of industry skills and
experience.

Education and communication have powered us to stay ahead of the technology spectrum and keep our
partners and people up to date delivering the best of solutions and services.

Coupling these traits keep Bluechip IT a step ahead in supporting all our IT Reseller and MSP’s to
achieve and win business by providing them not only a solution but a gateway to untapped
possibilities.

_crawl.linkedin_about: As a leading Digital Business Provider and AI Enabler, CANCOM leads companies, organizations and the public sector into the digital future. The range of services and solutions includes classic system house IT solutions as well as data-based digital solutions, managed services and cloud services. We accompany the digital evolution of our customers with passion and technology and support them in reducing the complexity of their IT and developing new business models. We offer a holistic portfolio for all IT and business requirements. The CANCOM Group's offering comprises innovative solutions in the areas of Artificial Intelligence, Security & Network, Datacenter & Cloud, IoT Solutions and Modern Workplace and includes services for the entire IT lifecycle – from the provision of IT infrastructures, planning and integration, to support, managed services and XaaS. Customers benefit from the extensive expertise with which their diverse requirements are translated into concrete industry-specific IT solutions to significantly promote their business success. The more than 5,300 employees of the internationally active CANCOM Group with around 80 locations in the DACH region, Belgium, Slovakia, Romania and the Czech Republic as well as an efficient partner network ensure market presence and customer proximity. The CANCOM Group is managed by Rüdiger Rath (CEO) and Thomas Stark (CFO). The company is headquartered in Munich. CANCOM generated annual revenue of around 1.7 billion euros in 2025. The Group parent company CANCOM SE is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in the TecDAX and SDAX (ISIN DE0005419105). Imprint: https://www.cancom.com/imprint-cancom/ Privacy: https://www.cancom.com/privacy-protection/ Our social media netiquette: https://www.cancom.com/nettiquete/

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

# Leading technology distribution: services and products for your business

We are enablers of the tech ecosystem with a profound calling to social and environmental
sustainability. To foster tech-democracy and accompany individuals and companies on their path to
technological innovation, Esprinet brings to Europe a comprehensive offer of consultancy, IT
security, services, and products for sale or rent through an extensive network of professional
resellers.

[ Become a client ][61]
[ Find out more ][62]

We are enablers of the technology ecosystem and, according to our philosophy, any project
characterized by technology must have a deep vocation for environmental and social sustainability.

We believe that new technologies represent a common good. That is why we are dedicated to being the
point of reference among the communities of technology manufacturers, retailers, and users.

Manufacturers

We work with more than 850 vendors, supplying their technologies to more than 30,000 business
vendors and consumers.

[ Find out more ][63]

Vendor

Being part of our network also means having a precise and clear view of the technology world's
trends and progress.

[ Find out more ][64]

Users

Our experience in the market and our extensive network enable us to stimulate the implementation of
technological innovations in business processes by directing companies, but also private users, to
the most suitable resellers.

[ Find out more ][65]

relevant_companies.summary: Indeks Bilgisayar serves as a distributor of smartphones and related products in Turkey, connecting manufacturers with retailers and customers.
relevant_companies.company_summary: Indeks Bilgisayar, 1989 yılında kurulmuş ve Türkiye genelindeki bilgisayar firmalarına geniş bir ürün yelpazesi sunan lider bir bilgisayar dağıtım şirketidir. Bugün, 250'den fazla dünya markasının distribütörlüğünü üstlenen Index Grup, bilişim teknolojileri alanında 600'den fazla çalışanı ve 8000'den fazla iş ortağı ile sektördeki öncülüğünü sürdürmektedir. Şirket, genç yetenekleri IT sektöründe çeşitli alanlarda kariyer yapmaları için arayışında olup, sonuç odaklılık, güvenilirlik ve yenilikçilik gibi temel değerlere önem vermektedir.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Index Grup Şirketleri, yolculuğuna İndeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret AŞ ile 1989 yılında başlamıştır. Türkiye genelindeki bilgisayar firmalarına, ihtiyaç duydukları tüm ürünleri, iyi organize olmuş bir bilgisayar dağıtıcısı kimliği altında sağlamak amacı ile kurulmuştur. Sürdürülebilir bir büyüme, şirket satın almaları ve halka açılımlar ile bugün sahip olduğu konuma gelmiştir. Index Grup, bugün itibariyle; üçü halka açık, üçünde yabancı ortaklık bulunan yedi firmadan oluşmakta ve 250'den fazla dünya markasının dağıtımını gerçekleştirmektedir. 600'e yakın sayıda çalışana ve 8000'den fazla sayıda iş ortağına sahiptir. 2001 yılından bu yana bilişim teknolojileri distribütörlüğünde liderliği elinde bulunduran bir şirketler grubu halini almıştır. Index Grup Şirketleri arasında bulunan şirketler: İndeks Bilgisayar AŞ Datagate Bilgisayar Malzemeleri AŞ Despec Bilgisayar AŞ Neteks Teknoloji Ürünleri AŞ Teklos Teknoloji Lojistik AŞ Index Grup, önümüzdeki 10 yıl için stratejik planlarını oluştururken, kariyerini IT sektöründe satış, pazarlama, ürün yönetimi, lojistik operasyonlar, dış ticaret, finans, muhasebe gibi alanlarda sürdürmek isteyen genç yetenekler aramaktadır. Index Grup'un temel değerlerini; sonuç odaklılık, güvenilir ve itibarlı olmak, yenilikçilik ve yetkin bir ekip olmak, yansıtan adayları grubumuza dahil etmek istiyoruz.

Bugün, 250'den fazla dünya markasının distribütörlüğünü üstlenen Index Grup, bilişim teknolojileri alanında 600'den fazla çalışanı ve 8000'den fazla iş ortağı ile sektördeki öncülüğünü sürdürmektedir. relevant_companies.company_summary: Intcomex is a leading value-added distributor of IT products dedicated to serving the Latin American and Caribbean markets. With a comprehensive inventory of over 5,700 products from more than 220 vendors, the company provides a wide range of computer equipment, peripherals, software, and digital consumer electronics to over 40,000 local customers across 45 countries. Operating from a state-of-the-art 221,000 square foot facility in Miami, Florida, Intcomex employs a dual distribution model as both a wholesale aggregator and an in-country distributor.

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

integrity of our information systems.

The identity of the unauthorised party is not known at this time, but is suspected to be affiliated
with the DragonForce ransomware group.

The scope of the compromise is still under investigation. We are working to analyse the types and
categories of personal information that may be affected and will issue further guidance as soon as
possible.

providers, employees or other individuals whose information was held within the affected IT

## Welcome to SAVEX

Your trusted ICT distribution partner with over 38 years of legacy in the industry. As one of the
prominent leaders in the distribution and technological solutions industry, Savex is determined to
deliver a quality experience to satisfy our clients with our services and facilitate businesses to
succeed in the current age of digital evolution.

Savex Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, with 107 sales offices  and 42 stocking locations
strategically spread across different regions of India.

This extensive reach, helps us to cater over 12,000 customers monthly, reaching out to over 1000
cities nationwide.

With the commitment to serve excellence, we bring to the table, and the market, top quality
distribution and technological solutions.

# Regional Distributor with Global expertise

Powering Telecom Success Across CEE and Beyond. With a unique blend of global partnerships and deep
regional insight, we deliver end-to-end telecom solutions across Central and Eastern Europe. From
market entry and brand strategy to logistics, financing, and aftersales care — our integrated
platform drives performance, scale, and speed for our partners. Let’s redefine what regional
distribution can do.

## Expertise that delivers.

### Business Development

With years of on-the-ground experience, we bring deep insight into local telco frameworks, shifting
market dynamics, and how consumers behave across the CEE region.

### Channel Marketing

Driving device sales and maximizing marketing returns through end-to-end product promotion, brand
strategy, and PR. Powered by expertise in retail channels and point-of-sale execution.

### Financial Services

Supporting our customers with working capital financing and enabling our suppliers with the
resources they need — our financial ecosystem, backed by top-tier institutions, fuels the flow of
business from production to delivery.

### Warehousing and Distribution

Our central warehouse in Prague offers distribution services to all Central and Eastern European
countries. With many customization stations, we efficiently ship over 10,000 items daily to meet our
customers' needs.

### Reverse Logistic and Aftersales Management

In partnership with manufacturers, we deliver comprehensive after-sales support — from tracking
DOA/DAP cases to managing authorized service centers and distributing spare parts across the region.

### Product Customization

Our customization services include everything from packaging updates and document insertion to
localized translations, app configuration, and software updates — ensuring each product meets market
or partner specifications.

# Global Distribution for Mobile Devices, IT Products & Consumer Electronics

Teleplus GSM Co. Limited is an international B2B distributor specializing in brand-new and certified
pre-owned mobile devices, IT hardware, consumer electronics, smart technology, and connectivity
solutions.

Headquartered in Hong Kong with operations across Belgium and the United States, we support
wholesalers, retailers, distributors, and business partners worldwide.

[ Contact Our Team ][79] [ Explore Products ][80]

### 📱 Mobile Devices

Brand-new and certified pre-owned smartphones, tablets, and mobile technology from leading global
brands.

### 💻 IT Products & PC Components

Computer hardware, storage solutions, networking equipment, business IT products, and performance PC
components.

### 🎧 Consumer Electronics

Smart devices, accessories, wearables, audio equipment, home electronics, and emerging technology
products.

### 🛰️ Smart Connectivity Solutions

Starlink equipment, communication technology products, drone solutions, and smart connectivity
infrastructure.

Built on More Than Two Decades of Industry Experience

Our experience in the mobile phone industry began in 2001 through retail and wholesale operations in
the Middle East. Over the years, we expanded internationally with sourcing and operational expertise
across Asia, Europe, and North America.

Today, Teleplus GSM continues to grow as a trusted international trading partner for mobile devices,
IT products, and consumer electronics.

Why Businesses Choose Teleplus GSM
🌍 International Distribution Network
📦 Reliable Inventory Supply
✅ Structured Quality Control
🚚 Global Logistics Coordination
🤝 Long-Term B2B Partnerships
🏆 Industry Experience Since 2001
Authorized MSI Reseller

Teleplus GSM is an authorized MSI reseller in Hong Kong, offering MSI gaming laptops and performance
hardware across multiple specifications and configurations.

Contact our sales team for product availability, pricing, and wholesale inquiries.

📱

### Refurbished Devices & Accessories

Teleplus GSM also supplies certified pre-owned smartphones, refurbished mobile devices, OEM
accessories, and original mobile solutions for global B2B partners.

📦

### Flexible Sample Orders

Minimum order quantities are available for sample purchases: Netherlands from 5 pcs, Hong Kong from
10 pcs, and USA from 50 pcs.

🚚

### Shipping & Transportation Policy

Products are carefully packed and inspected prior to shipment. Responsibility for transportation
risk transfers to the logistics carrier once the shipment has been dispatched.

kanálem. Odbornost našich zaměstnanců a masivní datová základna zajistí našim obchodním partnerům
konkurenční výhodu. Společnost eD system a.s. je součástí technologické skupiny eD group.

Patří mezi ně i kompletní špička trhu IT a spotřební elektroniky. Na nejvyšší partnerské úrovni
působíme coby oficiální distributoři značek** HP, Samsung, Acer, Western Digital, Canon, Microsoft**
a dalších uznávaných výrobců. Na náš sortiment a služby spoléhají přední české e-shopy i tradiční
prodejci IT a elektra. Zásobujeme například** Alza.cz, DATART nebo Amazon.**

partnerům i koncovým firemním zákazníkům přináší jednoduché a pohodlné nakupování s pokročilými

## Naše značky a projekty

Už od roku 1993 vytváříme český trh ICT, a to i vlastními značkami a zajímavými projekty.

[LYNX][23] je v České republice nejprodávanější značkou stolních počítačů do kanceláří, domácností a
pro hráče. Součástí nabídky jei příslušenství a dále různorodá kabeláž pro metalické a optické sítě.

eD Profi je otevřená síť více než 200 kamenných prodejen s IT technikou. Pobočky najdete ve všech
regionech České republiky.

eD EXPO a eD WORLD jsou přední odborné konference celorepublikového významu, během kterých na jaře a

## Naše značky a projekty

Už od roku 1993 vytváříme český trh ICT, a to i vlastními značkami a zajímavými projekty.

[LYNX][23] je v České republice nejprodávanější značkou stolních počítačů do kanceláří, domácností a
pro hráče. Součástí nabídky jei příslušenství a dále různorodá kabeláž pro metalické a optické sítě.

eD Profi je otevřená síť více než 200 kamenných prodejen s IT technikou. Pobočky najdete ve všech
regionech České republiky.

eD EXPO a eD WORLD jsou přední odborné konference celorepublikového významu, během kterých na jaře a
na podzim představujeme IT novinky přicházející na trh.

# Ban Leong Technologies Pte Ltd

## Our Brands

## 30 Years of Distribution Experience

With 33 years in the I.T distribution business - we curate, procure and distribute a wide range of
tech products across the region.
Ban Leong Technologies Pte Ltd empowers businesses and resellers with access to leading I.T brands

[ Read More ][35]

## What We Do

#### Retail Distribution

As a leading distribution partner in the industry, we work with large-format retail chains to
specialist tech stores and independent retailers to deliver market coverage and accessibility to
consumers. With a focus on demand generation, we possess dedicated resources in our sales and
marketing teams to drive vendor objectives.

#### Commercial Distribution

With a growing network of over 1,000 system integrators and resellers, our commercial division
strives to deliver the best solutions and products for your business. Lead generation, events, and
outbound marketing services are part of our extensive brand offerings and services to help you win
deals and grow your business.

#### Ecommerce Enablement

Working with Singapore's top e-commerce platforms, we actively manage official brand stores and
assist brands with the expansion of their online businesses and logistics operations in Singapore.
From product listing and campaign management to order processing and fulfilment, we partner with our
vendors to optimize their digital channels to maximize online visibility and drive conversions.

## Product Management

Going beyond traditional distribution models of “box-moving” services. Our Marketing and Product
teams are key drivers in delivering vendor objectives and managing brand portfolios in-country.

We also constantly focus on identifying innovative IT products in both commercial and consumer
segments to enhance and expand our range.

#### Sales and Marketing


At the heart of our company are our Sales and Marketing divisions. Dedicated to driving business and
creating value to our vendors and customers alike.

We actively seek opportunities in brand building and in-country marketing. Covering multi-channel
approach in Events, PR, Channel Marketing, Digital Marketing and Social Media.

#### Logistics Support


With an integrated inventory management system as well as warehouse storage facilities and our fleet
of delivery vehicles, we provide end-to-end logistic solutions for our vendors and customers.

Our shipping department also manages inbound and outbound shipments from our network of vendors
around the world.

#### After Sales Service


Leveraging on our expertise and knowledge on IT products, we offer aftersales services in terms of
repairs and replacement according to warranties offered by manufacturers.

Our technical support team operates hotlines and walk-in service centers at our office locations
regionally to fulfil product support queries.

### Why Bluechip

Bluechip thrives with solutions and technology in Australia & New Zealand, providing leading
business solutions for our value-added resellers, managed service providers, integrators and
consultants.

Our customers need end-to-end solutions for their network, security and cloud services to achieve
their transformation goals. Bluechip’s commitment is to create value for our Partners and their
customers by focusing on business outcomes delivered by technology through this journey.

[Learn More][33]
[Businessman,Hand,Touching,Map,Point,,,Global,Network,Communication,Technology]

### Leading Innovative Solutions

Established in 2000, Bluechip Infotech focuses on delivering the latest IT products to a wide
channel base while maintaining a dedicated commitment to first-class service. With offices across
Australia and New Zealand, we’re able to back our commitment to service through localised support.

Show MoreShow Less
[About Bluechip IT][34]

### Supporting Our People & Partners

Bluechip invests in its people and their education. You have the leverage to staff from various
backgrounds who can support your business with their diverse blend of industry skills and
experience.

Education and communication have powered us to stay ahead of the technology spectrum and keep our
partners and people up to date delivering the best of solutions and services.

Coupling these traits keep Bluechip IT a step ahead in supporting all our IT Reseller and MSP’s to
achieve and win business by providing them not only a solution but a gateway to untapped
possibilities.

Show MoreShow Less
[Learn More][35]
[Bluechip IT, Accountability]
[Business,Man,Handshake,With,Effect,Global,World,Map,Network,Link]

### Helping Your Business Grow

Forming optimal strategies and collaborating with more than 50 major technology vendors enables
Bluechip IT to offer our channel partners the best-in-class products, solutions, and services.

Our partnered vendors are industry leaders when it comes to IT hardware, software, telephony and
electronic security solutions.

Our value-added product management team has extensive vendor expertise, which provides turnkey
solutions from consulting, procuring, training, and right down to deployment of a project. This
allows us to support and contribute to our resellers to succeed.

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

# Leading technology distribution: services and products for your business

We are enablers of the tech ecosystem with a profound calling to social and environmental
sustainability. To foster tech-democracy and accompany individuals and companies on their path to
technological innovation, Esprinet brings to Europe a comprehensive offer of consultancy, IT
security, services, and products for sale or rent through an extensive network of professional
resellers.

[ Become a client ][61]
[ Find out more ][62]

We are enablers of the technology ecosystem and, according to our philosophy, any project
characterized by technology must have a deep vocation for environmental and social sustainability.

We believe that new technologies represent a common good. That is why we are dedicated to being the
point of reference among the communities of technology manufacturers, retailers, and users.

Manufacturers

We work with more than 850 vendors, supplying their technologies to more than 30,000 business
vendors and consumers.

[ Find out more ][63]

Vendor

Being part of our network also means having a precise and clear view of the technology world's
trends and progress.

[ Find out more ][64]

Users

Our experience in the market and our extensive network enable us to stimulate the implementation of
technological innovations in business processes by directing companies, but also private users, to
the most suitable resellers.

[ Find out more ][65]

###### Fabricantes

Somos la mejor opción para las principales marcas, que depositan su confianza en nuestro amplio
conocimiento de la industria para expandir su alcance en la región.

[Ver Más][43]

###### Retailers

Transforma la experiencia del cliente en el punto de venta.

[Ver Más][44]

###### Canales de valor agregado

Los clientes son la fuerza que impulsa a nuestra organización. El crecimiento de nuestros clientes
es nuestro principal objetivo.

[Ver Más][45]

###### Operadores

Para los operadores líderes en telecomunicaciones, el hecho de mantenerse enfocados en su propio
negocio jamás debería ser un desafío.

[Ver Más][46]

### Almacenamiento

Potencializa la demanda regional en localizaciones estratégicas a través de nuestro inventario de
disponibilidad inmediata especialmente concebido para garantizar la reposición y entrega expedita de
productos.

### Selección, empaque, flete y facturación

Intcomex dispone de un procedimiento flexible de selección, empaque y despacho con el fin de
preparar todo tipo de pedidos, sin importar su complejidad.

### Servicios de aduana e importación

La complejidad del comercio internacional jamás debe limitar la magnitud de tu participación en el
mercado.

### Seguimiento de pedidos


Gracias a nuestro sistema de gestión y seguimiento, es posible conocer el estatus de pedidos en cada
etapa del proceso de envío hasta que estos sean recibidos en su destino en perfectas condiciones y
en la fecha programada.

### Distribución local de mercancía


Nos encargamos de entregar tu producto donde lo necesites, a tiempo y dentro de tu presupuesto.
Contamos con una cadena de distribución fiable basada en una red de transporte y en la optimización
de rutas.

### Logística inversa


El fabricante por lo general gasta un porcentaje significativo de su ingreso total en procesar
devoluciones. El ciclo de la cadena de distribución no termina necesariamente con la entrega de
productos en su destino final.

**Date of Publication: 22nd July 2026**

Rectron (Pty) Ltd ("Rectron" / “we”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mustek Limited, recently
identified and responded to a cybersecurity incident affecting certain of our information technology

the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013.

address it and recommendations on protective measures which you can take to mitigate any possible
adverse effects.

On 15 July 2026, we became aware that our IT environment had been accessed unlawfully by an
unauthorised third party. As a result of the unauthorised access, data containing personal
information was accessed and potentially exfiltrated.

We commenced an investigation immediately with the assistance of external forensic specialists. We
are taking the necessary steps to contain, assess and remediate the incident and to restore the
integrity of our information systems.

The identity of the unauthorised party is not known at this time, but is suspected to be affiliated
with the DragonForce ransomware group.

**What personal information may have been affected?**

The scope of the compromise is still under investigation. We are working to analyse the types and
categories of personal information that may be affected and will issue further guidance as soon as
possible.

The affected data may include personal information relating to customers, business contacts, service
providers, employees or other individuals whose information was held within the affected IT
environment.

We take the privacy and security personal information extremely seriously. We have notified the
Information Regulator (South Africa) and have implemented various technical measures to strengthen
the security of our IT systems, apply enhanced monitoring and threat intelligence measures and to

We are working closely with external specialists to progress the investigation and to comply with
our legal and regulatory obligations. We are also liaising closely with the Board of our parent

### Samatel was established in 2018 in the Dubai Free Zone.

Starting from providing a wide variety of smartphones at wholesale prices took an even larger leap.
We have successfully shipped thousands of shipments to different countries like The UK, North

### Trusted Wholesale Technology Partner

## Apple Products

Authorized wholesale distributor of iPhones (13/14/15/16), iPads, and genuine Apple accessories.

## Apple Computers

Complete range of iMac, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro models with official warranty and authentic
Apple Care services.

## Mobile & Tablet Parts

Authentic LCD displays, touch screens, and repair components for all major mobile phone and tablet
brands.

## Lighting & Chandeliers

Premium selection of modern and traditional lighting solutions, including LED systems, chandeliers,
and designer fixtures for all spaces.

## TV & Electronics

Complete range of satellite receivers, digital TV equipment, and broadcasting solutions for home and
commercial use.

## Xiaomi Global Products

Official global version Xiaomi smartphones, tablets, and accessories.

## General Electronics

Wide selection of electronic devices, gadgets, and accessories from trusted international
manufacturers.

## Samsung Devices

Full lineup of Samsung Galaxy S, A, and Z series smartphones, tablets, and wearables.

with the latest and modern smartphone technology. We strive to bring consumers what they want and
need while maintaining our high-quality performance. Our Vision is to preserve the surplus of these
products and to keep our clients pleased.

### Competitive Pricing

We offer highly competitive rates for maximized profit margins

## Welcome to SAVEX

Your trusted ICT distribution partner with over 38 years of legacy in the industry. As one of the
prominent leaders in the distribution and technological solutions industry, Savex is determined to
deliver a quality experience to satisfy our clients with our services and facilitate businesses to
succeed in the current age of digital evolution.

Savex Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, with 107 sales offices  and 42 stocking locations
strategically spread across different regions of India.

This extensive reach, helps us to cater over 12,000 customers monthly, reaching out to over 1000
cities nationwide.

With the commitment to serve excellence, we bring to the table, and the market, top quality
distribution and technological solutions.

# Regional Distributor with Global expertise

Powering Telecom Success Across CEE and Beyond. With a unique blend of global partnerships and deep
regional insight, we deliver end-to-end telecom solutions across Central and Eastern Europe. From
market entry and brand strategy to logistics, financing, and aftersales care — our integrated
platform drives performance, scale, and speed for our partners. Let’s redefine what regional
distribution can do.
[ Tell me more ][8]
[The one solution for CEE]

## 20 countries

Instead of navigating 20 separate markets, our partners engage with one streamlined regional unit —
efficient, effective, and built for growth.

Business development in the Telco industry across all CEE countries.
Direct business with more than 150 partners from Telco, retail and e-commerce.
Our flexibility ensures we adapt to the specific requirements and priorities of every vendor partner

## Expertise that delivers.

### Business Development

With years of on-the-ground experience, we bring deep insight into local telco frameworks, shifting
market dynamics, and how consumers behave across the CEE region.

### Channel Marketing

Driving device sales and maximizing marketing returns through end-to-end product promotion, brand
strategy, and PR. Powered by expertise in retail channels and point-of-sale execution.

### Financial Services

Supporting our customers with working capital financing and enabling our suppliers with the
resources they need — our financial ecosystem, backed by top-tier institutions, fuels the flow of
business from production to delivery.

### Warehousing and Distribution

Our central warehouse in Prague offers distribution services to all Central and Eastern European
countries. With many customization stations, we efficiently ship over 10,000 items daily to meet our
customers' needs.

### Reverse Logistic and Aftersales Management

In partnership with manufacturers, we deliver comprehensive after-sales support — from tracking
DOA/DAP cases to managing authorized service centers and distributing spare parts across the region.

### Product Customization

Our customization services include everything from packaging updates and document insertion to
localized translations, app configuration, and software updates — ensuring each product meets market
or partner specifications.

# Regional Distributor with Global expertise

Powering Telecom Success Across CEE and Beyond. With a unique blend of global partnerships and deep
regional insight, we deliver end-to-end telecom solutions across Central and Eastern Europe. From
market entry and brand strategy to logistics, financing, and aftersales care — our integrated
platform drives performance, scale, and speed for our partners. Let’s redefine what regional
distribution can do.
[ Tell me more ][8]
[The one solution for CEE]

## 20 countries

Instead of navigating 20 separate markets, our partners engage with one streamlined regional unit —
efficient, effective, and built for growth.

## 140 million

Bringing your brand within reach of 140 million potential customers.
Local presence in 10 countries.

## Expertise that delivers.

### Business Development

With years of on-the-ground experience, we bring deep insight into local telco frameworks, shifting
market dynamics, and how consumers behave across the CEE region.

### Channel Marketing

Driving device sales and maximizing marketing returns through end-to-end product promotion, brand
strategy, and PR. Powered by expertise in retail channels and point-of-sale execution.

### Financial Services

Supporting our customers with working capital financing and enabling our suppliers with the
resources they need — our financial ecosystem, backed by top-tier institutions, fuels the flow of
business from production to delivery.

### Warehousing and Distribution

Our central warehouse in Prague offers distribution services to all Central and Eastern European
countries. With many customization stations, we efficiently ship over 10,000 items daily to meet our
customers' needs.

### Reverse Logistic and Aftersales Management

In partnership with manufacturers, we deliver comprehensive after-sales support — from tracking
DOA/DAP cases to managing authorized service centers and distributing spare parts across the region.

### Product Customization

Our customization services include everything from packaging updates and document insertion to
localized translations, app configuration, and software updates — ensuring each product meets market
or partner specifications.

Trusted Global Mobile Devices, IT Products & Consumer Electronics Distributor Since 2015

# Global Distribution for Mobile Devices, IT Products & Consumer Electronics

Teleplus GSM Co. Limited is an international B2B distributor specializing in brand-new and certified
pre-owned mobile devices, IT hardware, consumer electronics, smart technology, and connectivity
solutions.

Headquartered in Hong Kong with operations across Belgium and the United States, we support
wholesalers, retailers, distributors, and business partners worldwide.

[ Contact Our Team ][79] [ Explore Products ][80]

### 📱 Mobile Devices

Brand-new and certified pre-owned smartphones, tablets, and mobile technology from leading global
brands.

### 💻 IT Products & PC Components

Computer hardware, storage solutions, networking equipment, business IT products, and performance PC
components.

### 🎧 Consumer Electronics

Smart devices, accessories, wearables, audio equipment, home electronics, and emerging technology
products.

### 🛰️ Smart Connectivity Solutions

Starlink equipment, communication technology products, drone solutions, and smart connectivity
infrastructure.

Built on More Than Two Decades of Industry Experience

Our experience in the mobile phone industry began in 2001 through retail and wholesale operations in
the Middle East. Over the years, we expanded internationally with sourcing and operational expertise
across Asia, Europe, and North America.

Today, Teleplus GSM continues to grow as a trusted international trading partner for mobile devices,
IT products, and consumer electronics.

Why Businesses Choose Teleplus GSM
🌍 International Distribution Network
📦 Reliable Inventory Supply
✅ Structured Quality Control
🚚 Global Logistics Coordination
🤝 Long-Term B2B Partnerships
🏆 Industry Experience Since 2001
Authorized MSI Reseller

Teleplus GSM is an authorized MSI reseller in Hong Kong, offering MSI gaming laptops and performance
hardware across multiple specifications and configurations.

Contact our sales team for product availability, pricing, and wholesale inquiries.

📱

### Refurbished Devices & Accessories

Teleplus GSM also supplies certified pre-owned smartphones, refurbished mobile devices, OEM
accessories, and original mobile solutions for global B2B partners.

📦

### Flexible Sample Orders

Minimum order quantities are available for sample purchases: Netherlands from 5 pcs, Hong Kong from
10 pcs, and USA from 50 pcs.

🚚

### Shipping & Transportation Policy

Products are carefully packed and inspected prior to shipment. Responsibility for transportation
risk transfers to the logistics carrier once the shipment has been dispatched.
